ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:6 ratio of high-intensity pixels (localized at distal tips) to low-intensity pixels (dominant across the central and medial fluke body).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity black/grey across 85% of visible surface. High-contrast white contiguous blobs are mapped to the distal tips of both left and right lobes, with minor light-intensity mottling visible in the upper-medial regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Approximately 115-degree shallow V-shaped depression with a bounding-box depth approximately 10% of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 3 to 12 pixels, most prominent on the lateral halves of both trailing edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex trailing edge curve on both lobes, transitioning to a sharp upward sweep at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white circular clusters detected at the far right distal tip, consistent with barnacle-induced scarring.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular white pigmentation/scarring at the distal lateral tips of both lobes; potential minor irregular notch on the trailing edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant pixel occlusion caused by white-water spray across the lower central region where the fluke meets the water surface.
